title: CreditOfferResponse
description: Canonical contract for Chit Credit Offer response payload

member_id.description: Unique identifier of the chit circle member

eligible_amount.description: Pre-approved working capital limit in INR

interest_rate.description: Annualized percentage rate (APR) in percentage points

unlock_date.description: ISO-8601 date string or timestamp when the credit offer was generated/unlocked

partner_nbfc.description: Name of the NBFC partner issuing the simulated credit facility

is_eligible.description: Additive flag indicating whether member meets the minimum threshold for loan issuance

score_band.description: Additive score band that unlocked this offer

term_months.description: Additive recommended loan tenure in months

disclaimer.description: Additive clear notice that the offer is simulated mock data for hackathon demo
